metadata.name: hybrid_launch
metadata.description: Track A (SPL-404): classic SPL Token launch with fixed 1B supply and immutable LaunchConfig. Engine-independent. Devnet/localnet only.

instructions.name: register_dbc_launch
docs: Register a Meteora DBC-created token as a hybrid launch (ADR-014). Verifies DBC's pool, config
and mint, and creates the locked buffer ATA. Signed by the DBC pool creator, before graduation.

accounts.name: creator
docs: Pays rent; must be the DBC pool's `creator`. Holds no powers afterwards.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The mint DBC created. Typed as a classic SPL Token mint, so a Token-2022 mint is rejected.

instructions.name: register_plain_dbc
docs: Mode 1 curve path. Bind a DBC pool to a `PlainLaunchConfig` only when its config is on
`APPROVED_DBC_CONFIGS`. No ratio, collection, fee, or NFT. No wrap.

accounts.name: creator
docs: Pays rent; must be the DBC pool's `creator`. Holds no powers afterwards.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The mint DBC created. Typed as classic SPL, so a Token-2022 mint is rejected.

errors.name: InvalidDecimals

errors.name: ZeroCollectionSize

errors.name: CollectionTooLargeForSupply
errors.msg: collection_size * ratio exceeds the 1B supply

errors.name: ReservedFeeAboveCap
errors.msg: reserved (removed: token fee bps cap; there is no token fee)

errors.name: ReservedCaptureFeeBelowRerollFee
errors.msg: reserved (removed: capture vs re-roll fee ordering)

errors.name: ReservedFeeDestinationNotBurn
errors.msg: reserved (removed: burn fee destination)

errors.name: InvalidLaunchDestination
errors.msg: launch_destination is not the classic-SPL ATA of the launch_vault PDA for this mint

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: PostLaunchCheckFailed
errors.msg: Post-launch invariant check failed

errors.name: CollectionBelowMinimum
errors.msg: collection_size must be >= MIN_COLLECTION_SIZE (100)

errors.name: MintAccountInUse
errors.msg: mint address already holds data or is owned by a program

errors.name: SolFeeOutOfRange
errors.msg: tier SOL fee outside [MIN_FEE_LAMPORTS, MAX_FEE_LAMPORTS]

errors.name: CollectionAboveCap
errors.msg: collection_size above MAX_COLLECTION_SIZE (10,000)

errors.name: GraduationThresholdOutOfRange
errors.msg: graduation threshold outside [10 SOL, 100,000 SOL]

errors.name: ReservedGraduationUnfundable
errors.msg: Reserved (was GraduationUnfundable; affordability rule dropped with lazy minting, ADR-016)

errors.name: MintCostConstantStale
errors.msg: live rent for a Core asset exceeds the conservative constant

errors.name: FeeRecipientInvalid
errors.msg: fee recipient must be PLATFORM_FEE_RECIPIENT, system-owned, data-less and not executable

errors.name: DbcAccountInvalid
errors.msg: not a DBC pool/config account (owner, length or discriminator), or pool/config/mint don't match

errors.name: DbcConfigRejected
errors.msg: DBC config rejected: needs SOL quote, SPL token type, fixed 1B supply with no burn, immutable authority, our buffer as leftover receiver, and the launch's decimals and threshold

errors.name: DbcMintRejected
errors.msg: DBC mint rejected: needs classic Token, mint + freeze authority None, supply exactly 1B, the launch's decimals

errors.name: DbcCreatorMismatch
errors.msg: the signer must be the DBC pool's creator

errors.name: DbcAlreadyGraduated
errors.msg: the DBC pool has already migrated; register before graduation

errors.name: DbcConfigNotApproved
errors.msg: DBC config is not on the platform allowlist (APPROVED_DBC_CONFIGS)

errors.name: FeeNotTier
errors.msg: stored fee is not exactly the tier for the ratio (QA-FEE-03; 0 and off-tier fees are invalid)

errors.name: ExtensionsNotAllowed
errors.msg: Token-2022 mint must carry the transfer-fee extension and no other extension

errors.name: TaxBpsNotAllowed
errors.msg: transfer tax must be from 1 to 1000 basis points and is fixed at launch

errors.name: BuybackPriceNotAllowed
errors.msg: buyback price must be from 1 lamport to 1 SOL per whole token and is fixed at launch

types.name: LaunchConfig
docs: Immutable launch record for one Track A mint. PDA `["launch_config", mint]`.
There is NO instruction that modifies or closes this account: ratio,
collection size, SOL fees, fee recipient and mint are fixed at launch
(Stonk.fun lesson: no mutable economics after launch).

fields.name: creator
docs: Who paid for the launch. Holds no powers.

fields.name: mint
docs: Classic SPL Token mint; mint + freeze authority are `None`.

fields.name: launch_destination
docs: ATA(launch_vault, mint): received the full supply. Owned by the PDA below;
no instruction can move tokens out of it (distribution mechanism TBD).

fields.name: launch_vault
docs: PDA `["launch_vault", mint, launch_config]` owning `launch_destination`.

fields.name: ratio_whole_tokens
docs: Whole tokens per NFT (one of ALLOWED_RATIOS).

fields.name: ratio_base
docs: ratio_whole_tokens * 10^decimals.

fields.name: collection_size
docs: Number of NFTs in the collection.

fields.name: max_tokens_in_nft_form
docs: collection_size * ratio_base (<= total_supply_base).

fields.name: fee_lamports
docs: The flat SOL fee (lamports) charged on EVERY capture, release and re-roll, fixed forever
(ADR-013) = fee_for_ratio(ratio_whole_tokens) at launch; <= MAX_FEE_LAMPORTS (0.01 SOL).
There is no token fee.

fields.name: fee_recipient
docs: PLATFORM_FEE_RECIPIENT at launch time: the only address any fee can reach (F-06 / M-05).

fields.name: graduation_threshold_lamports
docs: Graduation threshold (lamports raised; DBC migration threshold). `graduation_slice_pct` is
always 0 since lazy minting (ADR-016); the field stays for the append-only layout.

fields.name: dbc_config
docs: DBC config of the curve (`register_dbc_launch`); default for native `launch` (never opens).

fields.name: dbc_pool
docs: DBC virtual pool of the curve. `hybrid_vault::graduation::verify` only accepts this pool, and
only once DBC reports it migrated. Default for native `launch` => the vault can never open.

types.name: LaunchParams
docs: Creator-chosen launch parameters (ADR-013 flat SOL fee model). Mode 2 only.

fields.name: graduation_threshold_lamports
docs: Graduation threshold (SOL raised on the curve), lamports. Default 85 SOL.

types.name: PlainLaunchConfig
docs: Immutable Mode 1 record: a classic SPL memecoin with no NFT pairing.
Same PDA seeds as [`LaunchConfig`] (`["launch_config", mint]`), different account type, so a mint
is one mode or the other and `hybrid_vault` cannot load this as a hybrid launch. There is no
instruction that modifies or closes it, and no field a creator can set after init.
Native [`crate::launch_plain`] leaves `dbc_config` / `dbc_pool` default and parks the supply in
the launch-vault ATA (nothing signs for that PDA). [`crate::register_plain_dbc`] is the curve
path: DBC already minted the supply into its base vault; this record only binds an allowlisted
config. Neither path has a ratio, a collection, a fee, or a wrap.

fields.name: mint_authority_bump
docs: 0 when DBC created the mint (`register_plain_dbc`). The native path stores the mint-authority bump.

fields.name: launch_mode
docs: Always [`crate::LAUNCH_MODE_PLAIN`].

fields.name: creator
docs: Who paid. Holds no powers.

fields.name: mint
docs: Classic SPL Token mint; mint + freeze authority are `None`.

fields.name: launch_destination
docs: Native: ATA(launch_vault, mint). DBC: the pool's base vault.

fields.name: launch_vault
docs: Native: PDA `["launch_vault", mint, launch_config]`. DBC: DBC's pool authority.

fields.name: dbc_config
docs: Default for native `launch_plain`. Allowlisted config for `register_plain_dbc`.

fields.name: dbc_pool
docs: Default for native `launch_plain` (not on a curve). The DBC pool for `register_plain_dbc`.

fields.name: graduation_threshold_lamports
docs: 0 for native `launch_plain`. Copied from the allowlisted DBC config on the curve path.

types.name: PlainLaunchParams
docs: Creator-chosen parameters for a Mode 1 plain launch. No ratio, collection, fee, or NFT field:
those do not exist on this mode. The flat-SOL tier table is Mode 2 only.

fields.name: tax_bps
docs: Transfer tax in basis points. 1..=1000. Locked by a None config authority.

fields.name: buyback_lamports_per_whole
docs: Lamports per whole token for the inventory buyback. 1..=1 SOL. Locked at launch.

constants.name: DBC_BUFFER_SEED
docs: Seeds of the single buffer-authority PDA named as every DBC config's `leftover_receiver`.
NO instruction signs with it (T-GRAD-03).

constants.name: DEFAULT_GRADUATION_THRESHOLD_LAMPORTS
docs: Default graduation threshold (DBC migration_quote_threshold): 85 SOL. DECIDED.

constants.name: LAUNCH_CONFIG_SEED
docs: `["launch_config", mint]`: one immutable config per launched mint. Its
existence proves the mint was created by this launchpad.

constants.name: LAUNCH_VAULT_SEED
docs: `["launch_vault", mint, launch_config]`: data-less PDA that OWNS the launch
destination token account (its ATA) holding the full 1B supply. No instruction
in this program signs with it, so no person can withdraw (QA-HL-02 / N2).
Distribution (bonding curve) is TBD and must be added under the program's
multisig + timelock upgrade process.

constants.name: MAX_COLLECTION_SIZE
docs: Hard cap on collection size for batched pre-mint at graduation (graduation-design §2.3/§4.2:
measured 0.00509 SOL per NFT). DECIDED (Barton 2026-09-25 4:55 PM MT): 10,000.
Effective max N = min(1B / ratio, MAX_COLLECTION_SIZE).

constants.name: MAX_FEE_LAMPORTS
docs: HARD CAP on the fee (M-08): exactly 0.01 SOL. A code constant: no launch parameter, instruction
or multisig action can raise it (only a program upgrade, 3-of-5 + 7-day timelock until the
post-audit freeze). hybrid_vault re-asserts it on every use.

constants.name: MAX_GRADUATION_SLICE_PCT
docs: Reference only since ADR-016 (was the max graduation slice for the pre-mint).

constants.name: MINT_AUTHORITY_SEED
docs: `["mint_authority", launch_config]`: temporary mint authority, revoked
(set to `None`) inside `launch` right after minting the fixed supply.

constants.name: MIN_COLLECTION_SIZE
docs: Minimum collection size for every ratio (Barton, 2026-09-24).

constants.name: MIN_FEE_LAMPORTS
docs: FLOOR (M-26 / M-30): the lowest tier. It must stay >= the 890_880-lamport rent-exempt minimum of
a 0-data system account so a transfer to an empty/missing recipient creates it instead of failing.

constants.name: TOTAL_SUPPLY_WHOLE_TOKENS
docs: Fixed total supply in WHOLE tokens (BRIEF hard requirement #1).
